note: Window agent p1890-p1899 (phase D). Keyframe overrides: USA 1890 and 1898 (Great Lakes waters), French Africa 1897 and 1898 (Mossi plateau, Gwiriko and Bagirmi the ledgers gave France), Ethiopia 1890, 1895 and 1898 (conquests the ledger dates 1886-1898). Events: Bosnia (Ottoman sovereignty and the Austro-Hungarian occupation), Gimirra, Dhofar. Ruling: Ethiopia over the Khedivate of Egypt. Reviewer (phase D): Ethiopia's three keyframes cut tributary Jimma's core; French Africa 1898 leaves Rabih's lower Chari to him until 1900; notes and quotes corrected.

region.text: the provinces of Bosnia and Herzegovina

events.note: Bosnia and Herzegovina 'came under Austro-Hungarian administration in 1878' but stayed 'nominally ... under sovereignty of the Ottoman Empire' until the annexation of 5 October 1908 (recognised 26 February 1909). The draft leaves the provinces to nobody from the austria-hungary_1880 keyframe on, so the Ottoman sovereignty is restored on the map here and austria-hungary/ledger/2's occupation is drawn over it.

region.text: the provinces of Bosnia and Herzegovina

events.note: Occupation of Bosnia and Herzegovina: 'The occupation of Bosnia and Herzegovina started on 29 July 1878' under the Treaty of Berlin ('The provinces of Bosnia and Herzegovina shall be occupied and administered by Austria-Hungary'), until 'In 1908, Austria-Hungary provoked the Bosnian crisis by formally annexing the occupied zone'. Restarts the occupation of austria-hungary/ledger/2 over the land events/0 returns to the Ottoman Empire (the draft holds it as nobody's from 1880).

region.text: Gimirra (Massonge is not in the gazetteer)

events.note: 'Finally, also in 1898, Ras Tassama annexed Massonge and Gimirra.' Replaces the skipped ethiopian-empire/ledger/48, whose region 'Massango' does not resolve; only Gimirra is drawn.

Dhofar is Omani from 1879: 'He was expelled by local sheikhs in January 1879' and Sayyid Turki 'established his rule there at the invitation of the Sayyids of Salalah'. The 1879 gain of sultanate-of-oman/ledger/15 does not reach the 1890 anchor (its 445 cells are nobody's from 1880 until the 1898 keyframe snap), so the land is restored at the start of this window; the page gives no 1890 event (bridge, confidence 2).

correction.text: the full extent with Alaska, the Great Lakes waters inside Michigan and Wisconsin included

keyframe_overrides.why: The 1890 keyframe was 'ok' but Cliopatria's shape leaves out the Great Lakes waters (Michigan 56 percent, Wisconsin 83 percent drawn), so 779 cells of Lake Michigan, Huron, Superior and Alaska fall to nobody in 1890 and return in 1898. Michigan's area includes '38,575 square miles of Great Lakes waters' and its 'western boundaries are almost entirely water boundaries ... with Illinois and Wisconsin in Lake Michigan'. The correction is the dossier's own 1880 shape on the 1890 outline.

rulings.why: The size rule gives the Harar plateau and the Afar edge to the Khedivate of Egypt in 1890-1898 (smaller Cliopatria area), though 'Egyptians withdrew in April 1884' from the Somali coast, the Hewett Treaty of 1884 ended the war with Ethiopia, and Menelik annexed Harar in 1887 ('Harar was annexed to the Kingdom of Shewa', Menelik II page, after Chelenqo on 6 January 1887).
